body.name: \operatorname{proj}_H
body.def: \(u\to v\) is in \(\operatorname{proj}_H(G)\) exactly when \((u,s)\to(v,t)\in E_G^{\to}\) for some \(s,t\in\mathbb T_H\), and \(u\leftrightarrow v\) is present exactly when \((u,s)\leftrightarrow(v,t)\in E_G^{\leftrightarrow}\) for some \(s,t\in\mathbb T_H\).
body.role: Forgets time indices while retaining edge type.
